verdict.line: You lose if you let Riven stack three Broken Wings casts and Ki Burst you for free; you win if you punish her cooldowns and Hookshot her off a wall reset.

brief.thesis: Camille vs Riven is a measured 46.2% win rate over 381 games in an otherwise even lane (46.2% vs Camille's 50.6% baseline), and the gap is almost entirely about tempo: Riven's Q (Broken Wings) resets on kill/assist and her E (Valor) blocks a trade instance, so if you swing when all three of her Q charges and E are up you're trading into a near-invulnerable burst combo instead of a fair fight.

tell.watch: Riven's Q charge count and E cooldown

theirWindow.when: all 3 Q charges and E ready
theirWindow.what: She can chain Broken Wings into a Valor block and knock you back on the third hit while Ki Burst (W, 11/10/9/8/7s cooldown) stuns if you're clumped near her passive Runic Blade auto. Do not stand still and trade autos here — she wins the extended fight.

yourWindow.what: Without Valor she has no damage block, so this is when your Q (Precision Protocol, 9/8/7/6/5s cooldown) empowered auto and W (Tactical Sweep) actually land full value. Walk up and force the trade the instant you see her use Valor for spacing rather than blocking.

powerCurve.note: neither has full combo online yet
Ki Burst stun plus 3 Q charges spike hard
Blade of the Exile ult adds range and AD
your item spikes start catching her up
Trinity Force/Hydra outscale her flat AD kit

start.why: Run at 46.9% win rate over 350 games and 75.9% pick rate; the extra sustain and AD let you match her early poke without folding to a level 3 all-in.

boots.why: 82.1% pick rate at 46.9% win rate; the flat physical damage reduction directly blunts her Runic Blade-empowered autos and Q (Broken Wings) poke.

core.why: Core first item in the 52.6% win rate path over 97 games; the damage and move speed proc let you punish when her E (Valor) is down.
Second item in the same build path; sustain and AoE let you win extended trades once you outscale her burst window.
Third item at 52.6% win rate over 97 games; bleeds through Riven's burst instead of eating it all at once, which matters against her all-in-heavy kit.

situational.when: she is landing full Ki Burst into Q combos and you need to survive the burst instead of just outdamage it
the lane is even by mid-game and you want to shorten your Q/W cooldowns to out-trade her cooldown-locked kit
you need the wave clear component early to answer her Broken Wings poke without losing CS

runes.keystoneWhy: Run at 45.2% win rate (27.6% pick); Grasp's proc and max-health scaling matter directly here because Camille's passive (Adaptive Defenses) already gives you a post-attack shield, and Grasp adds sustained health to survive her stun-into-burst instead of racing an all-in you don't have to win instantly.

summoners.why: Highest performing pair at 49.3% win rate and 65.9% pick rate; Ignite punishes her all-in the moment she commits her Q charges and E with no sustain to answer it.

playing.title: Track her Q charge count
playing.detail: Broken Wings has a 13s cooldown per full use but can chain 3 times in a short window; don't trade into her until you've seen at least one charge burn without landing.

playing.title: Bait Valor before committing
playing.detail: Her E (Valor) blocks incoming damage on a 10/9/8/7/6s cooldown; poke first with your Q auto to force it out, then commit your real trade.

playing.title: Respect Ki Burst radius after level 3
playing.detail: W (Ki Burst) stuns nearby enemies once she hits level 3; don't stand adjacent to her when her passive Runic Blade shows a full charge, since that's her signal she's about to engage.

playing.title: Use Hookshot to punish dashes
playing.detail: Your E (Hookshot, 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown) needs a wall — pre-position near lane walls so you can knock her up the instant she over-extends a Q chain.

playing.title: Save ult for her post-6 all-in
playing.detail: Once she hits level 6, Blade of the Exile gives her bonus AD and range plus one Wind Slash; your R (Hextech Ultimatum, 140/115/90s early) should be held to punish that all-in, not used to start your own.

playing.title: Play around Ignite, not extended trades
playing.detail: With a 46.2% measured win rate, don't try to out-sustain her in long fights — use Ignite plus a short trade window to end skirmishes early instead of letting her full combo play out.

playing.title: Prioritize CS over forced trades pre-6
playing.detail: Since the lane is statistically even, farming safely to hit your Trinity Force/Hydra spike matters more than forcing kills you don't have a clean read on.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, and summoner spells above are pulled from measured OP.GG data on the current patch (16.18.1) across the sample sizes listed; the tell, power curve, and trade-pattern reasoning are my own tactical read based on the ability mechanics, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Riven is strong when she reaches level 3 and level 6! Use your passive [P] to absorb as much damage when engaging! Rather than initiating combat yourself, try to respond to when Riven closes in!
